findings.reason: The authentic original standalone 1200×1400 PNG visibly prints the underscore and braces of H_{t,c}(W,h) in the title. The source title omits math delimiters, whereas the body already renders the corresponding algebra notation as math. This is an actual rendering defect rather than optional typography.
findings.action: Wrapped the exact existing H_{t,c}(W,h) title notation in inline dollar delimiters.

correction: Added inline math delimiters around H_{t,c}(W,h) in the title only. No notation was substituted and the complete body and all other frontmatter bytes are unchanged.

original_visual_evidence.inspection: Standalone original-resolution view; title defect independently confirmed; full visible body and remarks inspected.

final_native_visual_evidence.inspection: Inspected the final standalone PNG at original resolution. Title now renders H with the t,c subscript and (W,h) correctly, with no raw dollar signs, underscore, or braces; body and remarks remain legible and unchanged.
